provenance.container-bg: Banner.css --banner-background: var(--salt-container-primary-background) -> characteristics/container.css -> palette-background-primary -> snow #FFFFFF light / jet #101820 dark (variant=primary, the default)
provenance.content-fg: Banner.css color: var(--salt-content-primary-foreground) -> characteristics/content.css -> palette-foreground-primary -> #000000 light / #FFFFFF dark (does NOT vary by status)
provenance.tone-*: Banner.css --banner-borderColor: var(--saltBanner-borderColor, var(--banner-borderColor)) with .saltBanner-{status} { --banner-borderColor: var(--salt-status-{status}-borderColor) } -> characteristics/status.css -> palette-{info,negative,warning,positive} base (500 stop) -> theme/css/next/palette/{info,negative,warning,positive}.css, mode-invariant (500 stop is identical light/dark). SAME value also used by StatusIndicator.css's --statusIndicator-{status}-color -> status-{status}-foreground-decorative -> the identical palette-{role} token, so this one slot family serves BOTH style.root.border-color and style.icon.color, matching source truth exactly.
provenance.bg-*-secondary: Banner.css .saltBanner-secondary.saltBanner-{status} { --banner-background: var(--salt-status-{status}-background) } -> characteristics/status.css -> palette-{role}-weakest -> the 100-stop (light) / 900-stop (dark) of that color ramp
provenance.byDensity.banner-padding: Banner.css padding: var(--saltBanner-padding, var(--salt-spacing-50) var(--salt-spacing-100)) -> foundations/spacing.css spacing-50 (block axis) spacing-100 (inline axis), both density-scaled from the spacing unit (foundations/spacing.md)
provenance.byDensity.banner-gap: Banner.css gap: var(--salt-spacing-75) -> foundations/spacing.css, 0.75x the density unit
provenance.byDensity.banner-radius: Banner.css border-radius: var(--saltBanner-borderRadius, var(--salt-palette-corner, 0)) -> next/palette/corner.css [data-corner="rounded"] --salt-palette-corner: var(--salt-curve-150) -> foundations/curve.css curve-150, same rounded-edition pin as Calendar/Button (foundations/shape.md)
provenance.byDensity.banner-min-height: Banner.css min-height: calc(var(--salt-size-base) + var(--salt-spacing-100)) -> foundations/size.css size-base + foundations/spacing.css spacing-100, both density-scaled
provenance.byDensity.type-body: characteristics/text.css 'Body text (should be used as default)' block: --salt-text-fontFamily (Open Sans), --salt-text-fontWeight (fontWeight-regular=400), --salt-text-fontSize/-lineHeight (density-scaled, same body role as foundations/typography.md), used directly by Banner.css's font-family/font-size/font-weight/line-height declarations

structure.image.note: no leading-image concept — StatusIndicator is icon-only

structure.title.note: no dedicated title subcomponent in Banner/BannerContent — bold-first-line is a content-formatting convention only, see banner.stories.tsx 'Issue'/'MultipleLines'

structure.actions.source: BannerActions.tsx/.css — optional wrapper, min-height size-base, gap spacing-100

structure.close.note: no dedicated close part — a close-labeled Button composed inside the generic BannerActions, see banner.stories.tsx 'Dismissible'

behavior.role.note: Banner.tsx sets no role attribute; site/docs/components/banner/accessibility.mdx instructs the consumer to apply role="alert" or role="status" themselves depending on use case — a real, sourced absence of a default, not a research gap

prop.tone.source: Banner.tsx status?: ValidationStatus, default "info" -> status-indicator/ValidationStatus.ts ValidationStatusValues

style.root.background.note: variant=primary (default) — always the neutral container background regardless of status

style.root.background@emphasis.note: variant=secondary. Resolves through the tone indirection (defaults to bg-info-secondary, reassigned by the style.root.tone@* rows) — Banner.css .saltBanner-secondary.saltBanner-{status}

style.root.border-color.note: border color IS status-driven in Salt (unlike shadcn). Consumes the tone indirection slot, matching Banner.css's own `border-color: var(--banner-borderColor)` + per-status reassignment

style.icon.color.note: StatusIndicator resolves to the SAME palette-{status} value as the border — Salt is the only system where this is a distinct token from the body text color. Same tone indirection as the border

style.root.tone@destructive.note: not a Salt tone name — Salt's four-value enum is info/error/warning/success (see prop.tone)

style.title.font.note: no distinct title part to style (see structure.title)

style.description.color.note: BannerContent.css sets no color of its own — inherits content-primary-foreground from the root, i.e. the same value as style.root.color, not a separate token
